description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lyft is hiring a Software Engineer to build and maintain features from product specifications through deployment. The role focuses on frontend architecture, cross-functional technical collaboration, and contributing to architecture and product roadmap decisions.
Software Engineer owning web application features and driving React/TypeScript frontend architecture from specification through deployment and maintenance

Responsibilities:
• Build and own features end-to-end from product specifications through deployment and maintenance. Collaborate cross-functionally to drive frontend architecture and integrate emerging technologies into the infrastructure
• Build and own features end-to-end from product specs through deployment and maintenance, ensuring high quality at every stage
• Drive frontend architecture for modern web applications using React, TypeScript, and/or Next.js. Collaborate cross-functionally to integrate emerging technologies into our evolving infrastructure
• Shape the roadmap by contributing technical perspective on architecture decisions and business priorities
• Write maintainable code with comprehensive testing, clear documentation, and thoughtful design
• Mentor through code reviews that prioritize both quality and knowledge sharing
• Support your team through pairing, healthy technical debates, and a culture of mutual growth
• Interface with stakeholders to gather requirements, communicate progress, and respond to technical questions

Requirements:
• Requires a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
• Candidates must have at least 1 year of experience in software development or a related occupation
• Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
• 1 year of experience in job offered, software development, or related occupation
• Experience with Python and Flask
• Experience with AWS services (DynamoDB and SQS) and Kubernetes
• Experience with algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented programming
• Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases
